D: Three young waitresses at a pizza parlour in a Connecticut fishing town fall in and out of love one summer.
P: Serve the pizza when the food critic takes his first bite.
S: Caldo verde: potato and onion simmered in stock until soft, mashed smooth, finely shredded kale and slices of smoked sausage added for 5 minutes, olive oil on top.
the lobster boats in the harbour
Prawns sautéed in butter, garlic and chilli, splashed with white wine and lemon, parsley, with bread to mop up.
the dough nobody can leave alone
Pizza dough rolled into ropes and tied in knots, baked at 220C for 12 minutes, tossed in garlic butter, parsley and parmesan.
M: the sauce nobody will tell you about
Pizza dough stretched thin, a sauce of crushed tomatoes simmered with garlic, oregano, a little honey and a pinch of chilli, mozzarella, linguiça and peppers, baked on a hot steel.
Clams, prawns, new potatoes and corn steamed in a big pot with white wine, garlic, butter and chorizo, tipped onto the table.
W: Puff pastry rolled into a log, sliced, pressed into a muffin tin, filled with a custard of yolks, cream, sugar and lemon, baked at 250C until blistered.
K: a Connecticut summer down by the docks
Light lager straight from an esky of ice, a lemon wedge pushed into the neck of the bottle.

s.how: Simmer 600g potatoes and an onion in 1.2L stock until soft, then mash smooth. Add a bunch of finely shredded kale and 200g sliced smoked sausage and simmer 5 minutes. Drizzle with olive oil.

s.note: the dough nobody can leave alone
s.how: Roll 500g pizza dough into 12 ropes and tie each in a knot. Bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Toss straight away in 60g butter melted with 3 garlic cloves, chopped parsley and 30g parmesan.

m.note: the sauce nobody will tell you about
m.how: Simmer a tin of crushed tomatoes with 2 garlic cloves, oregano, 1 tsp honey and a pinch of chilli for 20 minutes. Stretch 500g dough thin, spread with sauce, top with 250g mozzarella, 150g sliced linguiça and capsicum. Bake on a hot steel.

w.how: Roll a sheet of puff pastry into a tight log, slice into 12 and press into a muffin tin. Whisk 4 yolks, 300ml cream, 100g sugar and lemon zest. Fill and bake at 250C for 12 minutes until blistered. Dust with cinnamon.

d.note: a Connecticut summer down by the docks
d.how: Bury eight 355ml bottles of light lager in an esky of ice for an hour. Push a lemon wedge into the neck of each and hand them out at the harbour.
